summary: Email Nick: Boise hiring package (Word doc) for review and posting
detail:
Draft in Kev's Superhuman Drafts (draft id draft0009dc8a67497b4f, thread draft0071e303715f0346; open: https://mail.superhuman.com/kev@edenexec.com/thread/draft0071e303715f0346). From kev@edenexec.com to nick@edenexec.com. Subject: Boise intern and recruiter postings, ready for your review. Body: Nick, Attached is the Boise hiring package: the internship posting with its four pathways, the remote or hybrid recruiter posting, offer letter templates for Sales and hourly interns, and a short intern compliance training for you, Bridger and me. Fill in the bracketed blanks (pay ranges, hours, start date, links), then post. Handshake at Boise State first for the internship, then Indeed and LinkedIn for both. A few lines were reworded for legal reasons; they are listed on page 1. Please keep those as written. Interns are hourly W-2 employees of Eden Partner Group, intern commission is TBD, and the recruiter role is open nationwide. Let's go through the 30-minute training together before the first interviews. Kev. ATTACHMENT (Kev attaches before sending; the Superhuman connector cannot attach files): projects/workforce/boise-internships/Eden Boise Hiring Package (for Nick).docx, 18 pages. Internal team email, no client names, no comp figures (pay is bracketed).

Numbers gate: 2026-10-23-f2f486 (cleared)
